name: readvideo
description: Turn YouTube videos and playlists into readable articles. Desktop app: Next.js renderer, Express-derived runners, Electron shell.

scripts.//setup: One command from a fresh clone: install, build all three, package the .app.
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:shell
scripts.//build: Order matters: the shell imports back-end/dist and serves front-end/out.
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --workspace electron
scripts.//dev: Two terminals: dev:renderer first, then dev:shell (which points the window at it for HMR).
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace electron && tsc --noEmit -p front-end && tsc --noEmit -p back-end
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace electron
scripts.//package: Full chain, then the macOS .app/.dmg into electron/release/.
